modelspec.diagram.DiagramGraphId.title: DiagramGraphId
modelspec.diagram.DiagramGraphId.description: The identity of a graph, derived and never drawn at random, so the same IR gives the same bytes (DESIGN.md § 13.5); the view's lower-case name, a slash and the graph's ir_hash, with `:<function>` after the view of an Infer graph drawn for `--function <function>`.
